bait-map-index.name: Bait Map Index
bait-map-index.description: Index bait-station maps they stored to account and ticket. List station ids as written.

callback-list.name: Callback List
callback-list.description: List open callbacks from their callback file and matching tickets.

chemical-log-completeness.name: Chemical Log Completeness
chemical-log-completeness.description: List application-log rows and flag blanks they use. Do not invent a mix, rate, or EPA number.

device-count.name: Device Count
device-count.description: Count devices from their bait-station map and match tickets or scan notes they stored.

estimate-from-price.name: Estimate From Price
estimate-from-price.description: Draft estimate lines from their price file and the lead or ticket they stored.

inventory-chem-vs-log.name: Inventory Chem Vs Log
inventory-chem-vs-log.description: Compare their chemical inventory sheet to application-log product names they already wrote.

route-day.name: Route Day
route-day.description: Build a day list from their route CSV and tickets. Apply the skip list first.

skip-list.name: Skip List
skip-list.description: Apply their skip rows to the route CSV. Skips win. Do not invent a skip to hide a miss.

wdo-form-completeness.name: Wdo Form Completeness
wdo-form-completeness.description: Check their WDO or termite form pack: form fields, graph present, photos named if they require them.
